register.notes: The producer register is commonly called TURRe; its public membership search is at jatehuoltokompassi.fi/haetietoja/turre/ (confirmed 2026-08-16). LVV EPR page fetched 2026-08-16 (LVV took over from Pirkanmaa ELY 01.01.2026): EPR explicitly applies to distance sellers, who without a Finnish branch must appoint an authorised representative; LVV recommends joining a producer organisation, which carries the legal obligations on behalf of the company. Exact register e-service entry point and possible state fees still to locate on LVV subpages.

pro.ecoModulation: Three recyclability classes per material (consumer packaging): plastic A mono 0.214 / B multi 0.274 / C difficult (incl. PVC, biodegradable, combination) 0.360 €/kg; fibre A 0.079 / B 0.162 / C 0.241; metal A 0.029 / C 0.063.

notes: Rates from the official Finnish Packaging Producers Ltd (SPT) 'Price list 2026' PDF on rinkiin.fi (fetched 2026-08-16), consumer packaging, detailed declaration, Class A (recyclable): paper fibre 0.079, plastic 0.214, glass 0.076, metal 0.029, wood 0.002, liquid carton (fibre class B) 0.162 €/kg ('composite'). B2B packaging is far cheaper (paper 0.003, plastic 0.065). Companies placing <50,000 kg/yr may use the light declaration form (flat: paper 0.102, plastic 0.238, metal 0.030, glass 0.076 €/kg consumer). Rinki business service fee 0.00199 €/kg, min €74/yr, max €3,890/yr; SPT registration fee €0. 2026 SUP fee list published later.
